name: jevcore-workspace
description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness: a framework-agnostic decision core and the DSH plugin built on it.

scripts.//check: Build runs BEFORE typecheck on purpose. Each adapter resolves the core through the `jevcore` workspace link, and the core's `types` entry is `lib/index.d.ts` — which does not exist until it is built. Typechecking first works on any machine that already has a `lib/` and fails on a clean checkout, which is exactly how CI caught it.
scripts.check: pnpm run legal && pnpm run build && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
